title: The Char
description: Aims to basically re-create the Nether Update with new blocks and items.
body:
Welcome to the Char! The Char aims to maker the Nether dimension more lively, more sustainable, and _finally_ more liveable. 
With new woods such as Pure wood, new blocks such as charsoil or mossy nether bricks for both colours, and even new plants like the bluebell, tnagletwitch, and gentian, this mod will make sure the _nature_ of the Nether becomes more to your taste!
**This mod is also avaliable in Polish.
**Made for the April 2026 MCreatives Mod Jam #1 - Nature themed.
I really hope this counts as nature.
